description: Sanitized derived aggregates for the KSC paper; private source artifacts and model outputs are not redistributed.

units.paper_table1: Macro-F1 in percent, rounded exactly as the paper
units.native_invalid_first_token_count: highest-logit vocabulary token was neither 0 nor 1; classification then used the greater 0/1 logit, so this is not a missing prediction count

desktop.decision: Use native vocabulary argmax when 0/1, otherwise compare 0/1 logits at the first response position; no explanation generation in these detection metrics.

hcx_baselines.runtime: Transformers F32 regardless of checkpoint storage precision
hcx_baselines.selection_note: teacher_baselines.csv uses evaluated-only counts and ecog_valid_only Macro-F1; four over-context Challenge cases are excluded, yielding n=1357 (667 phishing,690 normal). Native generated-response-format metrics are not mixed with the 0/1 logit rule.

android.sampling: Challenge finance/government x normal/phishing x three length strata, three samples per stratum; total 36
android.memory_measurement: Maximum app-wide PSS observed before/after decisions and at one-second intervals; not model weights alone. Speed and memory measured in separate runs.

selection.ranking: Recall descending, Macro-F1 descending, FPR ascending, block index ascending
selection.criterion: Highest observed Challenge Recall among the evaluated cumulative candidates with observed Challenge FPR <= 0.05

limitations: Test and Challenge were reused for candidate selection; they are not independent final holdouts.
Train/Test overlap includes 10 items; Train/Challenge has no exact normalized overlap as reported in the paper.
Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not correct candidate-selection bias.
Android results are paper-reported rounded aggregates from one device and one pass per model per measurement mode; this release contains no raw mobile ZIP.
Full-call offline detection metrics exclude ASR, explanation generation and warning delivery latency.
Original instruct models perform poorly under this task-specific prompt and label rule; these are not general-model capability estimates.
The final filtered distillation-training count and every training hyperparameter are not fully recoverable from the archived records; training is outside this release.
GPTQ exploratory runs are excluded; all final student quantization results here use llama.cpp GGUF Q4_0/Q8_0.
The student Q3_K experiment was excluded because 90 of 126 linear matrices fell back to Q4_0.
Teacher/student device comparisons differ in architecture, tokenization, quantization and file size; differences cannot be attributed to distillation alone.
privacy_filter: Only whitelisted aggregate numeric metrics and tensor-layout metadata were exported. No transcripts, per-example identifiers, per-example prompts, generated responses, token IDs, credentials, server addresses or absolute personal filesystem paths are included.
